payload.claim: `_reviewed_tree` restates the sha256 computation that `saffron.agents.artifacts.hash_artifact` already defines (`hashlib.sha256(raw.encode()).hexdigest()`), the exact function `session.py` uses to produce the `sha256` field being checked here. No gate catches a duplicated formula; the standing 'one source' rule asks for the helper to be imported rather than re-derived, so the two computations can silently diverge if either changes its encoding or algorithm.
